children: Valaris voluntarily supplemented its merger proxy with additional disclosures ahead of shareholder votes on its combination with Transocean.
The proposed deal would exchange each Valaris share for 15.235 Transocean shares.
The companies received shareholder demand letters alleging proxy disclosure deficiencies; Valaris denies further disclosure is legally required.
Updated Goldman Sachs analyses showed implied per-share values of $45.49–$64.66 for standalone Valaris and $55.67–$89.21 for the combined company.
The supplemental disclosures will not change the November 24, 2026, Valaris and Transocean shareholder meeting dates.
